mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meeting_ai_workflow_info (MEETING_NAME, TYPE, CREATE_TIME, MEETING_TYPE, CREATOR_EMP_NO, SCHEDULE_ID, MEETING_CENTER_ID, SESSION_ID, MEETING_CONTENT, VIDEO_MEETING_NO, CREATOR_DEPT_CODE, MEETING_ROOM, START_TIME, END_TIME, CREATOR_NAME, CREATOR_DEPT, CREATOR_POSITION) VALUES (#{meetingName}, #{type}, #{createTime}, #{meetingType}, #{creatorEmpNo}, #{scheduleId}, #{meetingCenterId}, #{sessionId}, #{meetingContent}, #{videoMeetingNo}, #{creatorDeptCode}, #{meetingRoom}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{creatorName}, #{creatorDept}, #{creatorPosition})

INSERT INTO meeting_ai_workflow_participant (MEETING_ID, MEETING_CENTER_ID, EMP_NO, NAME, DEPT, DEPT_CODE, POSITION) VALUES
(#{item.meetingId}, #{item.meetingCenterId}, #{item.empNo}, #{item.name}, #{item.dept}, #{item.deptCode}, #{item.position})
